A friend told me:
Once in our student days we were drinking at someone's dorm. So we wouldn't be seen from the street and wouldn't get caught, we hung blankets over all the windows. The "victim", waking up in total darkness with a hellish hangover, didn't understand where he was and couldn't remember anything from the previous evening. He tried to assume a vertical position — sat up, dangling his legs off the table. But his legs don't reach the floor!!! The poor guy realized he was sitting on some kind of elevation... He crawled around the table — pitch dark all around. He found some small change in his pocket, stretched out his hand and dropped the coins into the dark nothingness — the sound of impact never came (turns out, as it happened, the coins silently fell onto some junk under the table). And then the poor guy realized — he was in some cave, on a rock, forgotten and abandoned by all, almost like in Edgar Poe. So he screamed like he was being slaughtered))))))

429327: Sliva_rzn: I love Ryazan... First there was no hot water at home for three days. Then they cut off the gas for a day too, then the electricity as well. The apocalypse, in short. On Saturday they finally turned everything back on, but now BOTH taps run water at a temperature as if straight from the boilers of hell. I guess that's the housing office making up for lost time, trying to atone. At least they didn't pump gas into the water pipes...
429328:
Arrived from the dacha.
In the evening at the dacha — rain, thunderstorm, gusts of strong wind... At one point the lights went out for an hour.
We lit several candles. Mom is drinking tea and staring out the window, bro is reading a book with a headlamp, I'm glued to my tablet.
And then ... comes the F A T H E R! Namely: he'd snuck off fishing/boozing. The weather turned bad, he threw on a black raincoat and...
The door opens. Rain and wind burst into the room, a huge silhouette in a long cloak barely discernible in the dim flicker of the candles is lit up by a flash of lightning. A woman screamed but her cry was drowned out by the belated thunderclap. The tall figure heavily stepped over the threshold and shut the door. In the pitch darkness a phlegmatic child's voice sounded, with a hint of approval:
- Dope!
